label: kizuna_language_d_02
text: Pawmi here is as healthy as can be![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_03
text: Hahaha! Well, it seems being quiet is simply a\npart of this one’s personality![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_04
text: But it’s hard for a Pokémon to communicate with\nits fellows without speaking up.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_05
text: As you know, wild Pokémon use their cries to tell\neach other all sorts of things—like the location of\r\nfood or whether there are predators nearby.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_06
text: So even if I were to release it back into the wild,\nI’m afraid that it may not be able to do those\r\nsorts of things![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_07
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]What do you think, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?
Where
does
Pawmi belong?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_select_01
text: How about here?

label: kizuna_language_d_select_02
text: With you, Mr. Salvatore!

label: kizuna_language_d_08a
text: Here? At the academy?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_08b
text: Oh?! I didn’t expect to hear mon nom—my name![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_09
text: So you think it should stay here...with me![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_10
text: I was so focused on getting it back in good\nhealth so it could return to the wild that I didn’t\r\neven consider that possibility![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_11
text: What do you think about that idea, my little\nPawmi friend?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_poke_04
text: Pawmi!

label: kizuna_language_d_12
text: Pawmi! It spoke! At last![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_13
text: Even without speaking Pokémon language myself,\nI know that that reply means “yes”![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_16
text: All the more reason you should have this—here,\na rare Pokémon for you to raise![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_d_system_02
text: You received a Meowth from Mr. Salvatore!

label: kizuna_language_d_15
text: Ahhh, I’m so happy! Yes—I, Salvatore, will take\nit upon myself to look after Pawmi for good!\r\nI will indeed![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
